promptHead: Athlete goal: 5K (Corrowmore Harvest 5K) on Sun Nov 15 2026, 3 weeks out, target run the whole way.

new.headline: Pick up where you left off, not from scratch, with the same three mornings and a small step up on Saturday. The race is in 3 weeks, so let's talk honestly about what "run the whole way" can realistically look like.

answers.question: I haven't run for two weeks. Do I have to start again from the beginning? And is the 5K in four weeks still realistic?
answers.answer:
No, you do not start from the beginning. Two weeks off after the base you built in September is a pause, not a reset. Your lungs and legs remember more than you think, so we repeat last week's planned sessions and nudge Saturday up a little.

On the 5K itself, finishing is realistic. Running every single step without a walk break in 3 weeks is a stretch, and I would rather be straight with you than promise it. A fair target for Nov 15 is to cover the 5K, use short walk breaks only when you need them, and feel strong at the finish. If the next two weeks go well we can aim for longer run segments and fewer walks on race day, and if the day itself feels great you run through them. That is a result you can be proud of, and it sets you up to chase a continuous 5K soon after.

new.analysis:
## Why this week looks like this

The job this week is to get moving again at an effort that feels kind, not to chase what you missed. Three runs on your usual Mon, Wed, Sat rhythm, all walk-run, with Saturday the one that grows a little.

I am lengthening the run segments on Saturday from 2 minutes to 3 minutes, because the race goal is about running for longer stretches, not covering more ground. If 3-minute runs feel hard, drop back to 2 and 1 and tell me, no drama.

Keep everything conversational. If you can speak a full sentence while running, the pace is right; if you cannot, slow down or walk sooner. Low sleep and high stress raise your heart rate for the same effort, so trust how it feels over the watch this week.

## About the race

Three weeks is enough to make real progress from where you are, but not enough to turn 2 minutes of running into 30 minutes without a break. That is biology, not effort. If you want, we can also look at a follow-up 5K in December or January where "run the whole way" becomes the real target, and Corrowmore becomes the fun first one.

safetyCallouts.title: Look after sleep and stress.
safetyCallouts.body: Six hours with a lot on your plate is a big ask alongside new running. If sleep stays short or you feel wiped out, cut a session rather than push through, and lean on your GP or a counsellor if the stress at home is weighing on you.
